name: Fields of Grief
summary: Pumpkins are taken from a human farmstead north of Deathknell for the Royal Apothecary Society in Brill. Deathguard Simmer sends newly risen Forsaken to gather them.

sections.title: A Lesson in Survival
sections.body: Deathguard Simmer sends you from the crypts of Deathknell into a hostile land. He serves Sylvanas Windrunner's forces, where survival means taking what the living possess and putting it to use for the Undercity's darker aims.

sections.title: Raiding the Living
sections.body: The farm lies west of the road, north of Deathknell, where mortal human peasants work blighted soil. Simmer says they infest the realm like mold on a corpse. The farmers hold their homesteads under the uneasy protection of nearby Scarlet Crusade towers. Taking their crops strikes at their supplies and provides produce for the Royal Apothecary Society's research.

sections.title: Supplies for the Society
sections.body: Apothecary Johaan conducts experimental research in Brill, where the stolen pumpkins are delivered. The Royal Apothecary Society frequently uses local produce and flora as bases for alchemical brews, poisons, and plague research. Its work aims to secure the Forsaken's precarious foothold in northern Lordaeron.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Fields of Grief?
faq.answer: Deathguard Simmer gives you the assignment. He guards the road in southern Tirisfal Glades, just north of the path out of Deathknell.

faq.q: Where do I take the Tirisfal Pumpkins?
faq.answer: Take the ten Tirisfal Pumpkins to Apothecary Johaan in Brill, east in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why are there living humans farming in Tirisfal Glades?
aliases: why are humans in undead zone
faq.answer: The human peasants are remnants of Lordaeron's original population who survived the Third War and the Scourge plague. They cling to their homesteads near Scarlet Crusade guard posts and resist Forsaken dominion.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Johaan want pumpkins?
faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan wants pumpkins for the Royal Apothecary Society's research. The Society uses plants, blighted crops, and biological matter as testing agents and base components for alchemical mixtures, poisons, and experimental plagues.
Scarlet Crusade zealots patrol down from a nearby watchtower. They defend the human settlement and try to purge undead who approach the fields.

faq.q: What comes after Fields of Grief?
aliases: what is after fields of grief
faq.answer: After you deliver the pumpkins, Apothecary Johaan gives you another assignment of the same name. He hands you a pumpkin laced with his latest formula to take to a captured Scarlet Zealot in the cellar of the Gallows' End Tavern.

angles.text: As an Undead, this is your first military assignment outside Deathknell. You strip your former mortal kin of their livelihood to advance the Royal Apothecary Society.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure Tirisfal Glades by breaking the lingering human presence and dismantling Scarlet Crusade influence along the southern roads.
As a herbalist, you know apothecaries rely on Tirisfal's twisted flora for deadly concoctions. Every local root and crop can become a reagent of war.
